property_summary: After calling owned(), the owner should remain unchanged from what it was before the call
After calling owned(), the owner should be the same as the owner before the call.
After calling owned(), the owner should never be address(0).
After owned() is called, the owner should remain unchanged from before the call.
After a call to owned(), the owner must not become address(0) unless it was already address(0) before the call.
After calling owned(), the owner should be the address passed to transferOwnership, not msg.sender of that call.
After calling owned(), the owner should be the address passed to transferOwnership, not msg.sender of that call.
After calling transferOwnership(newOwner) followed by owned(), the owner should equal newOwner, not msg.sender.
owned() does not revert when called by the contract owner
Calling owned() after transferOwnership(newOwner) does not revert when called as the new owner
The owner address remains the initial owner after any call to transferOwnership with any address
